evidence: At 360x780 the document scrollWidth is 433 px against a 360 px clientWidth, so the page scrolls 73 px sideways. The large pagination row runs from x=12 to x=431.7; its last item ends 71.7 px beyond the viewport. The fixed navbar also expands to 433 px, leaving its menu toggle outside the initial 360 px view.
fix: Let the pagination row wrap (flex-wrap: wrap) or constrain it with max-width: 100% and an inner horizontal scroll container; keep the navbar at 100% of the viewport so its toggle remains visible.

evidence: The 70x70 circular control is at y=300 on phone and y=554.1 on laptop. Its 25.7x40 glyph is at y=318 / 572.1, putting the glyph center at y=338 / 592.1 while the control center is y=335 / 589.1: 3 px low in both viewports.
fix: Center the glyph with flexbox and line-height: 1, or apply the measured 3 px upward offset to the icon.

evidence: At 360x780 the table is 465.1 px wide at x=15 (right edge 480.1) and the document scrollWidth is 480 px, so the page scrolls 120 px sideways. The fourth column starts at x=369 and is entirely outside the 360 px viewport; the navbar also stretches to 480 px.
fix: Wrap the table in a .table-responsive container with overflow-x: auto, set the table to width: 100%, and allow the column content to wrap or shrink so the page itself never exceeds the viewport.

evidence: The Typography heading starts at x=15 and its 48 px text measures 356.8 px wide, ending at x=371.8. The viewport is 360 px wide, so the final letter is clipped by 11.8 px; the screenshot shows the heading cut at the right edge.
fix: Reduce the heading font size below 48 px at narrow widths or allow the heading to wrap/scale so its text width stays within the 330 px content box.

evidence: On hover, the source-code button is 84.9x42.4 px at (620.1, 396) with z-index 100. The modal close control is 44.6x53 px at (632.4, 425); the two boxes overlap by about 45x13.4 px, covering the top of the × control. The same collision appears on the other modal examples.
fix: Place the source button outside the modal's header area or reserve space for it; hide it for modal components and keep the close control unobstructed.

evidence: On phone the SVG is 270 px wide at x=45 (right edge 315), but the plotted series group is 281.9 px wide and ends at x=376.9, clipping 61.9 px. On laptop the SVG is 706.7 px wide (right edge 1395), while the series is 882.8 px wide and ends at 1621.1, clipping 226.1 px. The chart's right-hand data is cut off at the card edge.
fix: Render the chart against the measured container width (update Chartist on resize) and constrain the series to the SVG viewBox so its right edge stays inside the card.

evidence: The eight x-axis labels are each 26 px wide but are spaced only 25.65 px apart, from x=95 to x=304.4. Adjacent labels overlap and render as the continuous string '9:00AM12:00AM3:00PM...' in the phone screenshot.
fix: Show fewer x-axis ticks at narrow widths, or rotate/shrink the labels and increase their spacing so their boxes do not intersect.
